mock_data.title: A Sudden Decision
mock_data.passage:
'Have you any idea why Tom has left his job?' Fred asked Andy.

'Your guess is as good as mine,' replied Andy. 'I did hear that he was under a cloud when he left, but I think that was a rumour started by Jenny, one of his workmates, who doesn't like him. Tom has always been very hard-working and competent. I don't think he was dismissed. Whatever the reason, his resignation was a bolt from the blue. Everyone was surprised.'

Then Joan joined in the conversation, saying, 'He might have been bored. I would be climbing the walls if I had to sit in an office all day.'

'Quite the reverse,' replied Andy. 'Tom had a very interesting job and he loved it. He also liked his boss and the people he worked with.'

'I wonder if it is a case of cherchez la femme,' said Mary. 'My brother introduced Tom to an Australian girl called Mel a few weeks ago and they seemed to get on very well. I think my brother said that Tom and she had been out together quite a few times, but Mel is due to go back home fairly soon. Who knows? Perhaps Tom has decided on a life Down Under.'

'It's interesting that you should say that because Tom was talking about Australia just last week, but I didn't realize he had a new girlfriend. He never mentioned her,' said Andy. 'Still, we all know that Tom tends to be rather secretive and never talks about his affairs of the heart.'

'The plot thickens!' cried Sara. 'Tom was just talking the other day about doing some travelling, but I thought that he was just talking about his usual two weeks in Europe. It never occurred to me that he was talking about the other side of the world.'

'Well, there's no use in speculating,' said Andy. 'We'll just have to wait and see. I expect that Tom will tell us about his plans when he's ready to.'

Suddenly Tom appeared saying, 'My ears are burning! What have you all been saying about me?' He laughed when he was told about their guesswork. 'You have colourful imaginations,' he said. 'The truth is much less exciting than what you've come up with. I left my job to go back to university to do a further degree. I'm going back to the groves of academe.'

'I'm as clueless as you are,' Andy replied. 'I did hear a rumour that he was in trouble before he left, but I think that was just Jenny being malicious. She's never liked him. Tom's always been a really dedicated and capable worker. I doubt he was fired. Whatever the reason, his resignation came completely out of the blue. Everyone was really shocked.'

Joan chimed in, saying, 'Maybe he was just bored. I'd be dying of boredom if I had to sit in an office all day.'

'Actually, quite the opposite,' Andy countered. 'Tom had a very stimulating job, and he was really passionate about it. He also got on well with his boss and colleagues.'

'I wonder if a woman is at the heart of this,' Mary suggested. 'My brother introduced Tom to an Australian woman, Mel, a few weeks ago, and they seemed to really click. I think my brother mentioned that they'd been out together several times, but Mel's going back to Australia soon. Perhaps Tom's decided to start a new life Down Under.'

'That's interesting, because Tom mentioned Australia just last week, but I didn't know he had a new girlfriend. He didn't say anything about her,' said Andy. 'Then again, Tom tends to be quite reserved and never talks about his romantic life.'

'This is getting more interesting!' Sara exclaimed. 'Tom was talking about travelling the other day, but I just assumed he meant his usual two-week holiday in Europe. It never occurred to me that he was thinking about going to the other side of the world.'

'Well, there's no point in endless speculation,' said Andy. 'We'll just have to wait and see what happens. I'm sure Tom will tell us his plans when he's ready to.'

Suddenly, Tom appeared, saying, 'My ears are burning! What have you all been saying about me?' He laughed when he heard their guesses. 'You have quite the imaginations,' he said. mock_data.passageC1:
'Do you have any inkling as to why Tom tendered his resignation?' Fred queried, addressing Andy.

'Your surmise is as valid as mine,' Andy responded. 'I did pick up a rumour that he was under a cloud before he departed, though I suspect that was merely a fabrication spun by Jenny, a disgruntled colleague. Tom has consistently demonstrated diligence and competence; I highly doubt he was dismissed. Irrespective of the underlying cause, his resignation came as a complete bombshell. It caught everyone completely off guard.'

Joan then interjected, postulating, 'Perhaps he was simply stifled by the monotony. I, for one, would be driven to distraction if confined to an office environment day in, day out.'

'Quite the contrary,' Andy countered. 'Tom's role was remarkably engaging, and he derived genuine satisfaction from it. Furthermore, he held his supervisor and colleagues in high regard.'

'I wonder if we should cherchez la femme,' Mary mused. 'My brother introduced Tom to an Australian woman, Mel, several weeks ago, and they appeared to hit it off immediately. If I recall correctly, my brother mentioned that Tom and she had been seeing each other quite frequently. However, Mel is scheduled to return to Australia imminently. Could it be that Tom has contemplated a life Down Under?'

'It's rather apropos that you should mention that, as Tom was indeed discussing Australia just last week, although I was completely oblivious to the existence of this new girlfriend. He neglected to mention her,' Andy remarked. 'Nevertheless, it's common knowledge that Tom is rather circumspect and never divulges details regarding his romantic entanglements.'

'The situation is becoming increasingly convoluted!' Sara exclaimed. 'Tom was recently alluding to plans for extensive travel, but I assumed he was merely referring to his customary fortnight in Europe. It never dawned on me that he was contemplating a journey to the other side of the globe.'

'Well, there's little point in engaging in further conjecture,' Andy stated. 'We shall simply have to bide our time and await developments. I anticipate that Tom will disclose his intentions when he deems it appropriate.'

Suddenly, Tom materialized, proclaiming, 'My ears are burning! What exactly have you all been saying about me?' He chuckled upon being apprised of their speculative discourse. 'You certainly possess vivid imaginations,' he quipped. 'The reality is considerably more prosaic than your elaborate hypotheses. I resigned from my position to return to university to pursue a postgraduate degree. I'm returning to the hallowed halls of academia.'

questions.answer: Answers may vary. Examples: Why did Tom leave his job? Where is he going? Was he fired or did he resign? What is his sudden decision? Is there a romantic reason? What will he do next?
questions.question: Ask one question that you want answered after reading the passage.

questions.answer: Answers may vary. Reasons include: unexpected opportunity, strong emotional impulse, dissatisfaction with current situation, new information or insight, external pressure or deadline, romantic reasons, following a passion, spontaneous personality, avoiding overthinking, life-changing event.
questions.question: Why do you think someone would make a sudden decision?

questions.answer: Answers may vary. Arguments for: can lead to positive change, prevents overthinking, follows intuition, seizes opportunities, shows courage. Arguments against: may be impulsive, lacks careful consideration, can lead to regret, ignores consequences, emotional rather than rational. Many would say it depends on the situation and person.
questions.question: Do you think sudden decisions can be good decisions?

mock_data.translation:
"Tom nima uchun ishini tark etganligi haqida biror fikringiz bormi?" Fred Endiga so'radi.

"Sizning taxminingiz mening taxminimdan yaxshiroq," deb javob berdi Endi. "Men eshitdimki, u ketganida u bulut ostida edi, ammo menimcha bu uni yoqtirmaydigan ish do'stlaridan biri Jenni tomonidan tarqatilgan mish-mish edi. Tom har doim juda mehnatsevar va malakali bo'lgan. Menimcha u ishdan bo'shatilmagan. Sababi nima bo'lishidan qat'i nazar, uning iste'fosi osmondan tushgan chaqmoq kabi edi. Hamma hayratda qoldi."

Keyin Joan suhbatga qo'shilib, "U zerikkan bo'lishi mumkin. Agar men kun bo'yi ofisda o'tirishim kerak bo'lsa, devorga chiqib ketardim," dedi.

"Aksincha," deb javob berdi Endi. "Tomning juda qiziqarli ishi bor edi va u buni yaxshi ko'rardi. U shuningdek, rahbari va birga ishlagan odamlarni ham yaxshi ko'rardi."

"Menimcha bu ayolni qidiring holati," dedi Meri. "Mening akam bir necha hafta oldin Tomni Mel ismli avstraliyalik qiz bilan tanishtirdi va ular juda yaxshi til topishdi. Menimcha akam Tom va u bir necha marta birga bo'lishganini aytdi, ammo Mel yaqinda uyiga qaytishi kerak. Kim biladi? Balki Tom Avstraliyadagi hayotga qaror qilgandir."

"Siz buni aytganingiz qiziq, chunki Tom o'tgan hafta Avstraliya haqida gapirgan edi, ammo men uning yangi qiz do'sti borligini bilmagan edim. U uni eslatmagan," dedi Endi. "Shunga qaramay, biz hammamiz bilamizki, Tom sir saqlashga moyil va hech qachon yurak ishlari haqida gapirmaydi."

"Syujet qiziqarli bo'lib bormoqda!" deb qichqirdi Sara. "Tom bir kuni sayohat qilish haqida gapirayotgan edi, ammo men uning oddiy ikki haftalik Evropa sayohati haqida gapirayotganini o'yladim. Menga u dunyoning narigi tomoni haqida gapirayotgani hech oqilim kelmadi."

"Xo'sh, taxmin qilishdan foyda yo'q," dedi Endi. "Biz kutib ko'rishimiz kerak. Tom tayyor bo'lganda bizga o'z rejalari haqida aytadi deb o'ylayman."

To'satdan Tom paydo bo'lib, "Mening quloqlarim yonmoqda! Siz hammangiz men haqimda nima deb aytdingizlar?" dedi. U ularning taxminlarini eshitib kuldi. "Sizlarning tasavvuringiz rang-barang ekan," dedi u. "Haqiqat siz o'ylab topgandan ancha oddiy. Men universitetga qaytib, qo'shimcha daraja olish uchun ishimni tark etdim. Men ilm bog'lariga qaytib kelayapman."

hallowed halls.definition: A phrase used to refer to a university or other place of learning, especially one with a long and respected history.
hallowed halls.exampleUzbek: U doktorlik dissertatsiyasini davom ettirish uchun Harvardning muqaddas zallariga qaytdi.

cherchez la femme.uzbek: Ayolni qidiring (frantsuzcha ibora, erkakning g'alati xatti-harakatlarining sababi ayol ekanligini anglatadi).
cherchez la femme.example: Whenever a politician's career takes a sudden turn, people often cherchez la femme.
cherchez la femme.definition: Look for the woman (a French expression implying that a woman is the reason for a man's strange behavior).
cherchez la femme.exampleUzbek: Siyosatchining karerasi to'satdan o'zgarib ketganda, odamlar ko'pincha ayolni qidiradilar.

driven to distraction.example: The constant noise from the construction site was driving me to distraction.
driven to distraction.exampleUzbek: Qurilish maydonchasidan doimiy shovqin meni asabiylashtirardi.

mock_data.translationB1:
'Tom nima uchun ishdan ketganini bilasanmi?' deb so'radi Fred Andydan.

'Men ham bilmayman,' dedi Andy. 'Eshitishimcha, uning ishda muammolari bo'lgan ekan, lekin menimcha, Jenni buni boshlagan, chunki u uni yoqtirmaydi. Tom doim juda mehnatkash edi va ishini yaxshi bilardi. Men uni ishdan bo'shatishgan deb o'ylamayman. Sababi nimada bo'lishidan qat'i nazar, uning iste'fosi katta kutilmagan hodisa bo'ldi. Hamma hayron qoldi.'

Keyin Joan suhbatga qo'shilib, dedi: 'Balki u zerikib ketgandir. Agar men kun bo'yi ofisda o'tirishga majbur bo'lsam, juda bezovta bo'lardim.'

'Umuman unday emas,' deb javob berdi Andy. 'Tomning juda qiziqarli ishi bor edi va u bundan zavqlanardi. U, shuningdek, boshlig'ini va u bilan birga ishlaydigan odamlarni ham yoqtirardi.'

'Bilmadim, balki bu ayol tufaylidir,' dedi Mary. 'Akam Tomni bir necha hafta oldin Mel ismli avstraliyalik qiz bilan tanishtirdi va ular bir-biriga yoqib qolganga o'xshardi. Akamning aytishicha, Tom va u bir necha marta uchrashgan, lekin Mel tez orada uyiga qaytib ketadi. Balki Tom Avstraliyaga ko'chib o'tishga qaror qilgandir.'

'Bu qiziq, chunki Tom o'tgan hafta Avstraliya haqida gapirayotgan edi, lekin men uning yangi qiz do'sti borligini bilmasdim. U menga aytmadi,' dedi Andy. 'Lekin biz hammamiz bilamizki, Tom juda sirli va o'zining shaxsiy hayoti haqida gapirmaydi.'

'Bu yanada qiziqarli bo'lyapti!' dedi Sara. 'Tom yaqinda sayohat haqida gapirayotgan edi, lekin men uning odatdagi ikki haftalik Yevropa sayohatini nazarda tutgan deb o'yladim. Men u dunyoning narigi chetiga borishni nazarda tutgan deb o'ylamagandim.'

'Xo'sh, taxmin qilishdan foyda yo'q,' dedi Andy. 'Biz shunchaki kutishimiz va ko'rishimiz kerak. O'ylashimcha, Tom o'z rejalari haqida tayyor bo'lganda aytadi.'

To'satdan Tom paydo bo'lib, dedi: 'Quloqlarim qizib ketyapti! Hammasi meni nima deyapsizlar?' U ularning taxminlarini eshitib kuldi. 'Sizning tasavvuringiz juda ajoyib,' dedi u. 'Haqiqat siz o'ylagandan ancha kam qiziqarli. Men universitetga boshqa daraja olish uchun o'qishga qaytish uchun ishimni tashladim. Men yana maktabga ketyapman.'

'Тom nima uchun **ishdan bo'shash haqida ariza topshirganiga** hech qanday tasavvuring bormi?' - deb so'radi Fred Andidan.

'Men ham senchalik **bilmayman**, - javob berdi Andi. - U ketishidan oldin **muammoga tushgan** degan mish-mishni eshitgandim, lekin bu shunchaki Jennining yomon niyati deb o'ylayman. U uni hech qachon yoqtirmagan. Tom har doim juda sadoqatli va **qobiliyatli** ishchi bo'lgan. Uni ishdan bo'shatishganiga shubham bor. Sababi nima bo'lishidan qat'i nazar, uning iste'fosi butunlay kutilmagan edi. Hamma juda hayratda qoldi.'

Joan **gapga qo'shilib**, shunday dedi: 'Balki u shunchaki zerikkan. Agar men har kuni ofisda o'tirishga majbur bo'lsam, **zerikib o'lardim**.'

'Aslida, aksincha,' - dedi Andi. 'Tomning juda qiziqarli ishi bor edi va u bunga juda **qiziqar edi**. U, shuningdek, boshlig'i va hamkasblari bilan yaxshi munosabatda edi.'

'Hayronman, bu ishning **markazida** bir ayol bormikan?' - dedi Mary. 'Akam Tomni bir necha hafta oldin avstraliyalik Mel bilan tanishtirdi va ular bir-birlariga mos tushgandek tuyuldi. O'ylashimcha, akam ularning bir necha marta birga yurishganini aytgan edi, lekin Mel tez orada Avstraliyaga qaytib ketadi. Balki Tom "Down Under"da **yangi hayot boshlashga** qaror qilgandir.'

'Bu qiziq, chunki Tom o'tgan hafta Avstraliya haqida gapirgandi, lekin uning yangi qiz do'sti borligini bilmasdim. U u haqida hech narsa demadi,' - dedi Andi. 'Garchi, Tom odatda juda tortinchoq va hech qachon **shaxsiy hayoti** haqida gapirmaydi.'

'Bu tobora qiziqarli bo'lyapti!' - deb hayqirdi Sara. 'Tom yaqinda sayohat qilish haqida gapirayotgan edi, lekin men shunchaki uning odatdagi ikki haftalik Yevropadagi ta'tilini nazarda tutgan deb o'yladim. U dunyoning boshqa tomoniga borish haqida o'ylayotgani **hayolimga ham kelmagan edi**.'

'Xo'sh, **cheksiz taxminlar** bilan shug'ullanishning ma'nosi yo'q,' - dedi Andi. 'Nima bo'lishini kutishimiz kerak. Ishonchim komilki, Tom rejalari haqida aytishga tayyor bo'lganda bizga aytadi.'

Birdan Tom paydo bo'lib, shunday dedi: 'Qulog'im qizib ketyapti! Hammangiz men haqimda nima deyapsizlar?' U ularning taxminlarini eshitib kuldi. 'Sizlarda juda boy tasavvur bor ekan,' - dedi u. 'Haqiqat sizlar **o'ylab topganingizdan** ancha kam qiziqarli. Men aspiranturaga o'qish uchun universitetga qaytish uchun ishimni tashladim. Men **ilmiy dunyoga** qaytyapman.'

'Тomning nega ishdan ketish haqida ariza berganiga hech qanday ishorangiz bormi?' deb so'radi Fred Andydan.

'Sizning taxminingiz mening taxminimchalik asosli,' deb javob berdi Andi. 'U ketishidan oldin uning ustida qora bulutlar bor edi degan mish-mishni eshitgandim, lekin menimcha, bu shunchaki norozi hamkasbi Jennining to'qimasi edi. Tom doimo tirishqoqlik va malaka ko'rsatdi; U ishdan bo'shatilganiga ishonmayman. Asosiy sababidan qat'i nazar, uning iste'fosi to'liq portlash bo'ldi. Bu hammamizni butunlay hayratda qoldirdi.'

Keyin Joan aralashib, shunday dedi: 'Balki, u shunchaki bir xillikdan siqilgandir. Men, masalan, kun bo'yi ofis muhitida qamalib qolsam, aqldan ozish darajasiga yetardim.'

'Aksincha,' deb javob berdi Andi. 'Tomning roli juda qiziqarli edi va u bundan chinakam zavq olar edi. Bundan tashqari, u o'z rahbari va hamkasblarini hurmat qilardi.'

'Biz cherchez la femme qilmasakmikan?' deb o'yladi Meri. 'Akam bundan bir necha hafta oldin Tomni avstraliyalik Mel ismli ayol bilan tanishtirdi va ular darhol kelishib ketishdi. Agar xotiram pand bermasa, akam Tom va uning tez-tez uchrashib yurganini aytgan edi. Biroq, Mel yaqinda Avstraliyaga qaytishi kerak. Tom Avstraliya tomonlarda hayotni o'ylayotgan bo'lishi mumkinmi?'

'Sizning bu haqda gapirganingiz juda o'rinli, chunki Tom o'tgan hafta Avstraliya haqida gapirayotgan edi, garchi men bu yangi qiz do'stining borligidan butunlay bexabar edim. U bu haqda aytmadi,' dedi Andi. 'Shunga qaramay, Tomning juda ehtiyotkor ekanligi va hech qachon o'zining romantik munosabatlari haqida ma'lumot bermasligi hammaga ma'lum.'

'Vaziyat tobora murakkablashib bormoqda!' dedi Sara. 'Tom yaqinda keng ko'lamli sayohatlar rejalari haqida gapirayotgan edi, lekin men u shunchaki odatiy ikki haftalik Yevropaga sayohatini nazarda tutyapdi deb o'ylagandim. U dunyoning narigi tomoniga sayohat qilishni o'ylayotgani hayolimga ham kelmagan edi.'

'Xo'sh, bundan keyin taxmin qilishdan foyda yo'q,' dedi Andi. 'Biz shunchaki kuta turamiz va voqealarni kuzatamiz. Tom o'z niyatlarini zarur deb hisoblaganda oshkor qiladi deb o'ylayman.'

Birdan Tom paydo bo'lib, dedi: 'Quloqlarim qizishyapti! Sizlar men haqimda nima deyapsizlar?' U ularning taxminiy suhbatidan xursand bo'lib kuldi. 'Sizlarda tasavvur juda kuchli ekan,' dedi u hazillashib. 'Haqiqat sizning murakkab farazlaringizdan ancha oddiyroq. Men universitetga magistraturada o'qish uchun lavozimimdan iste'foga chiqdim. Men akademiyaning muqaddas zallariga qaytyapman.'
